title: MoE routing tap trace manifest (RT-2.1 trace-shape rider)
description: Header of one routing-tap capture. The per-token rows (columns below) and the int16 id tensor [rows, n_layers, top_k] are bound by sha256. An aggregate-only dump is not a valid trace: token order, sample boundaries, the prefill/decode tag and the speculative block size are mandatory, so RT-6/RT-7 can derive [steps, layers, experts] counts.

batch_size.description: -b used for the capture; prefill chunk length

layers.description: One entry per MoE layer, in layer order. n_experts may differ per layer (deepseek41 mixes 256-expert layers with 128-expert DSpark layers).

id_dtype.description: RT-1 adjustment 1: int8 overflows the 256/512-expert fleet

samples.description: Sample boundaries. Rows [start_row, start_row + n_rows) belong to sample_id, in token order.

columns.description: Fixed per-token row columns, in this order.

shape_note.const: [rows, n_layers, top_k] row-major; layers with smaller top_k pad with -1

row.description: Semantics of one token row (documentation of the columns; rows are stored columnar/binary, validated by trace_shape.py).

pos.description: token index within its sample; strictly increasing within a sample (token order kept)

step.description: forward-pass index within the sample; every row of one forward shares it (a prefill chunk, a decode step, a speculative verify block)

spec_block.description: tokens in this row's forward: n_tokens of the chunk for prefill, 1 for plain decode, the verify block size for speculative decode

spec_accepted.description: decode rows of a speculative block: whether the row's token was accepted; null for prefill and non-speculative decode
